newsitem.title: USA: More Californians upbeat about economy - poll.
newsitem.headline: More Californians upbeat about economy - poll.

text.p: Forty-five percent of Californians believe they are better off financially today than one year ago, according to a poll released on Monday.
While 34 percent of those surveyed described the state's overall economy as strong, 42 percent said the state was in bad economic times, the Field Institute poll found.
The findings from the Field poll included the following:
* 39 percent of Californians expect the economy to improve over the next 12 months, while 14 percent expect the economy to worsen.
